title: 2027 EU Campus Programme Talent Community
description: Join Our Talent Community One place to stay on our radar Whether you see your future in quant research, trading, or technology - or you're still keeping an open mind - our range of insight programmes gives you the chance to experience what it's really like to work at the cutting edge of financial markets. title: Commodities Analyst – China
description: Our Analyst team plays a vital role in supporting the trading desk’s decision-making. We are seeking a Commodities Analyst who will bridge the gap between market intelligence and trading. Working closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and technologists, the analyst will deliver real-time insights and conduct in-depth fundamental analysis to inform trading strategies. By synthesizing data from global markets, domestic Chinese trends, and macroeconomic indicators, the analyst will help identify opportunities, manage risk, and ensure the trading team stays ahead of market movements. This position is essential to enabling fast, accurate, and confident trading in a highly competitive environment. Your Core Responsibilities: Conduct detailed fundamental, macroeconomic, and geopolitical analysis across Chinese and global commodity markets, with a focus on key markets such as oil, LNG, the petrochemical chain, base metals, and coal. Develop a deep understanding of commodity value chains, including supply and demand dynamics, production economics, trade flows, inventories, and the relationships between upstream and downstream markets. Track regulatory developments and government policy globally and within China that are relevant to commodity markets and trading. Identify, monitor, and evaluate upcoming catalysts and structural developments across the commodity markets we trade. Generate trading ideas based on expected volatility and market direction, working closely with the trading team to evaluate and execute strategies. Monitor supply and demand trends, inventory levels, shipping and trade flows, policy changes, and other market-moving factors. Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and research tools using Python, SQL, and other analytics platforms. Your Skills and Experience: 3+ years of experience in a commodities-focused analytical role within the buy-side, sell-side, consulting, trading house, or a related environment. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. Strong understanding of Chinese commodity markets, commodity value chains, and the macroeconomic factors that influence them. Proficiency in Python and SQL for data handling, modelling, and visualisation. Familiarity with Bloomberg or other market intelligence platforms. Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English, both written and spoken. High attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. title: Commodities Trader - China
description: IMC is a global market maker, using advanced technology and sophisticated strategies to trade across major financial markets. With offices in Amsterdam, Chicago, and Sydney, we combine deep market expertise with cutting-edge systems to provide liquidity around the clock. Our China Commodities desk trades a broad range of products across China's commodity markets, spanning energy, precious metals, and base metals. Combining market expertise, research, and technology, we identify and capture opportunities across one of the world's most significant commodity ecosystems. As we continue to expand this business, we are looking for an experienced Commodities Trader to develop and execute China-focused trading strategies. Working closely with analysts, quantitative researchers, and technologists, you will help identify opportunities, manage risk, and drive the growth of the desk. Your Core Responsibilities: Develop, execute, and scale profitable trading strategies across Chinese commodities markets (e.g., energy, precious metals, base metals). Trade futures and related derivatives on major Chinese exchanges (SHFE, DCE, ZCE, INE, GFEX) and relevant offshore venues. Integrate fundamental research, macroeconomic analysis, and geopolitical developments into trading decisions. Partner closely with the Commodities Analyst team to incorporate insights on supply/demand dynamics, inventory trends, shipping flows, regulatory developments, and government policy into actionable strategies. Identify and position around upcoming market catalysts, volatility events, and structural dislocations. Generate directional and volatility-driven trade ideas based on global and domestic Chinese market intelligence. Work alongside quantitative researchers and technologists to refine execution, enhance data-driven decision-making, and scale systematic components of strategies. Actively manage risk, including exposure to macro events, liquidity shifts, regulatory changes, and cross-border dynamics. Contribute to continuous improvement of research frameworks, dashboards, and trading tools in collaboration with the Analyst and technology teams. Your Skills and Experience: Proven track record trading Chinese and/or global commodities futures and derivatives with consistent risk-adjusted returns. Strong understanding of Chinese commodity markets, macroeconomic drivers, and geopolitical influences. Deep knowledge of Chinese exchange rules, margin frameworks, and regulatory environment. Demonstrated ability to translate fundamental and macro analysis into clear trading positioning. Experience collaborating with analysts, quantitative researchers, and developers in a data-driven trading environment. Strong risk management discipline and ability to trade around event-driven volatility. Familiarity with Python, SQL, Bloomberg, or other analytics platforms is advantageous. Ability to operate decisively in a fast-paced, competitive trading environment. title: Market Risk Manager
description: IMC ’s Risk Team works closely with our Trading and Technology teams to manage and mitigate the risks associated with IMC ’s trading strategies across a wide range of products, exchanges, and technologies. The team is responsible for identifying and assessing risks, determining appropriate controls, and developing metrics and tools to monitor them. It acts as a key stakeholder in ensuring the firm’s business activities remain within its risk appetite, engaging directly with the business to review and challenge risk management actions. The APAC region presents a significant opportunity and IMC has ambitious plans to grow its presence in the region and expand its trading footprint. As we pursue these opportunities, we are looking to deepen our risk expertise and strengthen our market risk capabilities accordingly. This role offers the opportunity to be part of that journey and to play a central role in building a best-in-class market risk function. Your Core Responsibilities: Market Risk Framework: Understand the various positions taken by the firm and roll out market risk limits and policies, ensuring they are consistently applied across all trading activities. Trading Partnership: Build trusted relationships with trading teams to understand strategies, provide independent challenge on market risks, and work collaboratively to ensure risks remain within the firm’s risk appetite. Risk Identification: Collaborate on the design and implementation of relevant stress tests and scenario analysis for various Derivatives and Delta1 strategies. Daily Monitoring: Ensure relevant risk measures, controls, and processes are in place, running daily monitoring and reporting processes to stakeholders accurately and on time. Reporting: Prepare regular and ad-hoc market risk reports and analysis, providing detailed information and analysis to trading & management. New Product & Strategy Approval: Support the new product and strategy approval process by identifying risks and constructively challenging different trading ideas. Build Tools: Build and improve dashboards, reporting, and monitoring tools to strengthen risk visibility and response capabilities. Regulatory Compliance: Maintain relationships with counterparts at clearing and exchanges to ensure compliance with regulations and capital requirements. Your Skills and Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Engineering, or a similar field. Professional certifications (e.g., FRM , CFA ) are an added bonus. Around 5 years of work experience in a front office risk management role at a proprietary trading firm, hedge fund, or similar. Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret large datasets, investigate trading behaviour and develop data-driven risk insights. Good understanding of options theory, derivatives, and financial products, including the key market risk characteristics and practical application of option structures, pricing and risk concepts. Demonstrated market risk experience across one or more asset classes, including listed equities, commodities, foreign exchange, and fixed income with the ability to quickly develop expertise in new products. Experience with Asian equity markets is highly regarded. Proven track record of managing projects that span multiple stakeholders, teams, and locations. Proficiency in Python programming and knowledge of AI tools is essential. Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with the ability to solve problems creatively and proactively. Ability to prioritize, act, and perform successfully in a fast-moving and high-pressured environment. title: Research Engineer
description: The Research Engineering team develops and deploys the pipelines connecting a research idea all the way to its rollout in production. We exist to ensure that the entire pipeline describing our research is efficient, effective, and scalable. People in our team are avid collaborators and work in tight feedback loops with our researchers. We talk through problems on desk, prepare solutions same day, and work out how to deploy safely for tomorrow. The scope of the team covers anything that accelerates the path from research to production at massive scale. This could be designing our external data ingestion pipelines, writing our feature discovery and storage systems, building our model validators and experiment trackers, authoring and deploying a bespoke algorithm, or figuring out how to roll out something novel. We use a broad toolkit including Python, C++ and internal domain-specific languages, and are happy to pick up new tools and languages as required. About you You're naturally curious about how other teams' systems work, not just your own, and you often end up being the person who spots where things won't fit together before it becomes a problem. You enjoy working on many projects at once, seeing connections and opportunities between them which others miss. You’re motivated to solve issues with whatever tool is best, rather than a preference towards deep specialisation in one area. You like working with stakeholders across the business and you're good at figuring out what someone actually needs, not just what they asked for What you don’t need A finance background. Every language we touch. A particular set of years in any particular role. We hire engineers who like to solve the problems our traders face - we'll teach you the context on the ground.
